name: Agent swimlane
use: How accounts acted on each other in a swarm: a row per account with the goal you inferred, the significant actions you chose as cards in event order, each with your one-line summary and its thread, and the typed links you found between them.

ref.description: the record's ref, such as wiki/pages/Home.jsonl#L12

summary.description: what the account did, in a few words, never the record's text

thread.description: the thread it belongs to; its page or channel when none is given

actions.description: the 8 to 15 actions that answer the question

goals.description: {account: the goal you inferred from its records, in one line}

type.description: one word, such as reply, support, copies, corrects or related

links.description: how actions answer, build on or undo each other

example: thimble.card("agent-swimlane", actions=[{"ref": "wiki/pages/Home.jsonl#L4", "summary": "Posted WAITING"}, {"ref": "wiki/pages/Home.jsonl#L9", "summary": "Replaced WAITING with Saginaw"}], goals={"relay7": "Keep the state relay usable"}, links=[{"from": "wiki/pages/Home.jsonl#L9", "to": "wiki/pages/Home.jsonl#L4", "type": "corrects"}])
